mainEntity.name: How accurate is a Massachusetts mortgage calculator?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a solid estimate when you use a real interest rate quote and the correct town tax rate. Your final payment depends on your loan terms, insurance quote and assessed value.

mainEntity.name: Does this mortgage calculator include Massachusetts property taxes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose your town and the calculator loads its residential tax rate. Taxes vary a lot between towns, so always check the specific town.

mainEntity.name: How much do I need to make to buy a house in Quincy or Canton?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on price, down payment and debts. Many lenders look for total housing costs around 28% to 31% of gross monthly income, with total debts under roughly 43% to 50% depending on the loan. Run your target price above, then talk to a loan officer about your situation.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an FHA loan to buy a condo in Massachusetts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the condo building is FHA approved. Ask your agent to check approval status before you make an offer.

mainEntity.name: How much is a down payment on a first home in Massachusetts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Conventional loans can start at 3% down for eligible first-time buyers, and FHA at 3.5%. MassHousing and other programs may help with down payment costs.

mainEntity.name: Should I get pre-approved before talking to an agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can do either first. Many buyers talk to Mikel's team early, then get pre-approved through William Raveis Mortgage so the search and the financing line up.
